lines.text: In 1953, the CIA started secretly drugging Americans. With LSD.

lines.text: It was called Project MKUltra. The goal? Find a way to control the human mind.
lines.title: PROJECT MKULTRA
lines.say: It was called Project M.K. Ultra. The goal? Find a way to control the human mind.

lines.text: Agents dosed people who never agreed to it. Some never even knew.

lines.text: In 1973, the CIA director ordered the files destroyed.

lines.text: But about twenty thousand pages survived. They had been misfiled.

lines.text: In 1977, they were read out in the United States Senate.

In 1962, America's top generals signed a plan to fake terror attacks against their own country.
lines.say: In nineteen sixty-two, America's top generals signed a plan to fake terror attacks against their own country.

lines.text: The ideas? Blow up a US ship at Guantanamo. Fake the hijacking of a plane. Stage a terror campaign in Miami.

lines.text: Every attack would be blamed on Cuba, to justify an invasion.
